faq.q: What flood questions should I ask on a Ladner townhome?
faq.a: Whether the complex is within 30 m of a stream, slough or ditch (the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area), and how the strata's depreciation report and insurance treat Ladner's setting behind the City's flood-protection system — over 63 km of dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection, 31 drainage pump stations and about 538 km of drainage infrastructure.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Ladner freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Ladner?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Ladner?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
